fixed.problem: PATCH /alerts/{id}/status crashed with a 500 for any display name containing characters outside Latin-1 (for example 'Łukasz' or Arabic 'علي'): Starlette's set_cookie raised UnicodeEncodeError. The crash happened AFTER update_alert had saved the change and written the audit row, so the page reported an error for a change that was already saved, and the cookie was never set, so every later change failed the same way. Names with control characters ('Ann\x00', 'a\r\nSet-Cookie: x=1') also gave a 500 (http.cookies.CookieError) after saving, and were written into the audit trail as they were.
fixed.fix: Added valid_name(): 1 to 100 characters and str.isprintable(). It is checked before update_alert, so a bad name gets the 400 'Type your name' fragment and no audit row. The mg_actor cookie now stores quote(actor, safe='') and actor_of() reads it back with unquote(). A cookie that is not valid now counts as 'no name', so the form asks for the name again. New tests: test_any_name_works_and_is_remembered (José, Łukasz, علي, 'Ann Lee': first and second change both 200, audit actors correct) and test_bad_names_are_refused (newline, NUL, blank, 101 characters give 400 and no audit row).

fixed.problem: GET /timeline?ip=...&end= accepted any float. end=nan, inf, -inf, 1e20, -1e20 and even 1e12 all returned 500, because utc_time()/datetime.fromtimestamp failed. That is reachable from the hidden 'end' field or a hand-edited URL.
fixed.fix: end is now Query(None, ge=0, le=LAST_TIME), where LAST_TIME = 253402300799 (9999-12-31 23:59:59 UTC; checked with datetime(9999,12,31,23,59,59,tzinfo=UTC).timestamp()). I checked that pydantic's ge/le refuse nan and ±inf with 422. The constant sits inside the AHM-06 section, so docgen's AHM-03 cut still removes it. New test: test_timeline_refuses_an_impossible_end (nan, inf, -1, 1e20 give 422).

fixed.problem: Mutation testing showed that tests missed these breakages: dropping the backslash check in safe_next (an open redirect: browsers read /\evil.example as //evil.example), removing notify_change() after a status change (open queues stop refreshing live), dropping HttpOnly/SameSite from the mg_mode cookie, and adding 'unsafe-inline' to the CSP script-src.
fixed.fix: Parametrized test_mode_switch_never_redirects_off_site over //evil.example/, /\evil.example/, https://evil.example/ and javascript:alert(1). Added test_status_change_refreshes_open_queues (app.state.changes goes up by one). test_mode_switch_sets_the_cookie now asserts httponly and samesite=lax. test_pages_return_200_with_the_layout now asserts script-src 'self'; and no 'unsafe' in the CSP. All four mutations are now caught.

fixed.problem: Test counts were stale (37 tests, '766 passed'), and nothing described the name rules or the end= bound.
fixed.fix: Updated to 53 tests, the Python 3.13 run, and the whole unit suite result. Documented the end= range and the name rules with the percent-encoded mg_actor cookie, including why (the old 500).

findings.problem: My fix adds 'from urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n' to routes.py. The script's AHM-02 stage (v1) cuts actor_of/valid_name and the AHM-03 section, so web_routes_v1.py keeps an unused import. With the project's ruff config: web_routes_v1.py:18 F401 `urllib.parse.quote` and `urllib.parse.unquote` imported but unused. No assert fails; the script ran and printed 'wrote the AHM-02 and AHM-03 dashboard snippets'. The 4 I001 errors on the snippets were there before my change: run from docgen/, ruff does not know maxguard is first-party.
findings.suggestion: In routes(), next to the line that removes 'import time\n' for v1, add: v1 = sub(v1, "from urllib.parse import quote, unquote\n", ""). I ran the derived v1 and v2 test snippets against the derived v1 and v2 routes in a /tmp copy: 18 passed and 39 passed.

findings.problem: Nothing on the console ever calls EventStore.prune(). grep finds no '.prune(' outside sensor/shipper.py and agent.py. Yet ARCHITECTURE (the diagram 'events, 7 days', the privacy row 'events kept 7 days') and the timeline's empty-state text ('Events are kept for 7 days') promise 7-day retention. Events from uploads stay in data/events forever.
findings.suggestion: The lead or Jaiden adds retention, for example prune(older_than=now-7d) after each upload in the API or in a periodic task, or changes the docs and the timeline text.

findings.problem: The queue calls list_alerts() with its default limit=200 and the caption says 'N alerts' without saying the list was cut. alerts_for_ip() reads only the first 1000 alerts. On a busy rack sensor, alerts can silently disappear from the queue and from the timeline's 'Alerts involving this address'.
findings.suggestion: Show '(only the first 200: use the filters)' when len(alerts) == limit, as the timeline already does. The timeline could use a store query by IP (needs a StateStore method: lead/Jaiden).

findings.problem: same_connection() is applied even when an event's event_id exactly equals a cited record_id. Today every rule makes single-connection findings, so this is harmless. A future aggregated finding (scan or beacon with dst_port 0 or None) would lose its exact record_id links.
findings.suggestion: Accept an exact event_id == record_id match without the host/port check, and keep the host/port check only for uid and Community ID matches. Debatable; left for the lead.

findings.problem: Home mode says 'Device involved: {{ alert.src_ip }}'. For inbound findings (for example a decoy hit, where src is the outside scanner), the 'device' shown is the attacker, not the user's device.
findings.suggestion: Pick the address that is on the user's network (or show both in plain words). Decide together with JON-04's Home text.

findings.problem: No test covers IPv6 normalization on /timeline. Mutating 'ip = str(ipaddress.ip_address(ip))' to only validate was not caught, so an upper-case IPv6 address would silently match nothing.
findings.suggestion: Add a test with one event between documentation addresses 2001:db8::1 and 2001:db8::2, queried as 2001:DB8::1.

verified_facts: The steps were checked against docs-spec/roadmap/ahmad.md AHM-02, AHM-03 and AHM-06: file paths, the router, cookies mg_mode/mg_actor, hx-get/hx-target/hx-select on both filters, EventSource('/api/stream') -> htmx.trigger('#alerts','refresh'), hx-trigger='refresh, every 30s', hx-post with hx-encoding on /upload, id='ev-<record_id>' rows with #ev- chips, the ai.reason banner, Home text from load_home_text()[rule_id], hx-patch /alerts/{id}/status with update_alert(..., at=time.time()), the timeline validated with ipaddress (400) and default 24 h up to 7 days, and /assets joining report['devices']. All conform. The builder explained its deviations (4-link nav, extra /mode and /favicon.ico, end= parameter, uid plus host/port linking).
The pipeline now puts report['devices'] = build_device_table(log_dir) (pipeline.py line 116). Device rows have the keys ip, mac, host_name, dns_names, first_seen, which is what join_devices reads.

The CSRF middleware in app.py (refuse_cross_site_changes) covers the web router's POST /mode and PATCH /alerts/{id}/status. The tests check this with Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site and Origin: http://evil.example (403).

Starlette's RedirectResponse percent-encodes control characters in next=: '/\t/evil.example' becomes Location '/%09/evil.example' (ran it). Together with safe_next, the mode switch cannot redirect off the site.
A name with a ';' cannot inject a cookie: SimpleCookie quotes it ('mg_actor="A\073 mg_mode=home"'), and mode stayed analyst (ran it).

Before the fix: actor 'علي' or 'Łukasz' gave a 500 with set-cookie None, but the audit row was written (ran it). Starlette Response.set_cookie raises UnicodeEncodeError ('latin-1' codec) for 'علي' and CookieError for '\r\n' and '\x00' (ran it). Python's http.cookies._LegalChars includes '%', so percent-encoded values pass unquoted.

Pydantic/FastAPI Query(None, ge=0, le=253402300799) answers 422 for nan, inf, -inf, 1e20 and -5, and accepts 0 and 253402300799 (ran it). datetime(9999,12,31,23,59,59,tzinfo=UTC).timestamp() == 253402300799.0.

In the vendored htmx 2.0.11 (version:"2.0.11" in the file), the default responseHandling is [{code:'204',swap:false},{code:'[23]..',swap:true},{code:'[45]..',swap:false,error:true}], and the file reads meta[name="htmx-config"]. The keys includeIndicatorStyles, allowEval, allowScriptTags and selfRequestsOnly are all in the file (grep).
The vendored htmx sha256 is d6fdc75f204e6bdefa99b69bf1e6d4ac69b8a364f77929f45c13476b4000f717 (test_htmx_file_is_the_reviewed_one passes).
zeek -D is used for uploads (maxguard/zeek/runner.py docstring). The uid collision across the telnet and cert_expired fixtures is asserted in a test that passes.
app.css has no url(), @import or http references. The screenshots have no PNG text or EXIF chunks. alert-home.png shows only lab address 172.18.0.3.

docgen/make_web_snippets.py ran with no failed assert after the fixes. The section markers '# ---------- AHM-03: alert detail ----------' and '# ---------- AHM-06: timeline and assets ----------' are unchanged.
